name: FormFork Connect
author: FormFork

sections.description:
FormFork Connect adds a top-level FormFork studio menu to WordPress Admin pre-configured for https://formfork.io:

  1. Top-Level FormFork Menu & Guided 3-Step Onboarding Wizard:
    • 60-Second Setup Wizard: Connect your ff_live_... API key in one click, launch a ready-made form from 4 Starter Templates (Contact & Inquiry, Lead Capture & Project Quote, Customer Experience Survey, Client Intake & Digital Sign-Off), and auto-generate a draft WordPress page with the form pre-embedded.
    • All Forms: View all synced workspace forms with 1-Click Copy buttons for both Native and Hosted Iframe shortcodes, Edit Authority Lock badges (Editable Everywhere, Locked: WordPress Only, Locked: Dashboard Only), a Sync Now cache refresh button, and + Create New Form. (Form deletion is safely restricted to the FormFork Web Dashboard).
    • Form Builder: Full-featured visual Form Builder with Multi-Step Wizard support, 15 field types (including Digital Signature Pad, Evaluation Matrix, and File Upload with size & format limits), Edit Authority Lock selector, half/full column widths, dropdown/radio/checkbox options, conditional visibility logic (Show when Field X equals Y), 9 visual theme presets, and a side-by-side Live Interactive Form Preview.
    • Settings: Pre-configured with https://formfork.io as the default Platform URL, live Test API Connection diagnostics, and automatic Scoped Key detection (displaying project group and allowed domain restrictions).
  2. Gutenberg Block, Elementor Widget & Classic Editor Form Picker:
    • Elementor Page Builder: Drag and drop the native FormFork Form widget (eicon-form-horizontal), choose any synced form from the Elementor sidebar dropdown, pick from 9 visual themes, and preview it live inside the Elementor canvas.
    • Block Editor (Gutenberg): Search for FormFork Form (formfork/form-embed) to select any synced form from a dropdown and customize render mode or theme in the block sidebar.
    • Classic Editor: Click the Add FormFork Form button next to Add Media to pick a form and insert the shortcode automatically.
  3. Server-Side WordPress AJAX Proxy & Transient Caching:
    • Routes schema fetches and form submissions (including binary multipart/form-data file attachments) through WordPress admin-ajax.php so your ff_live_... API key stays private on the server and cross-origin CORS issues are eliminated.
    • Automatically resolves and cryptographically signs each visitor’s IP address (X-FF-Visitor-IP + X-FF-Proxy-Sig HMAC-SHA256) so visitors on shared WordPress hosting never share a rate-limit bucket.
    • Caches synced workspace forms and form schemas for 60 seconds using WordPress Transients for fast admin and frontend performance.

Shortcode Usage

  • Standard Native Embed: [formfork id="your-form-id"]
  • Override Theme / Button Label: [formfork id="your-form-id" theme="frosted-crystal" button_text="Get Started"]
  • Hosted Iframe Embed: [formfork id="your-form-id" mode="iframe" height="620"]

External Services

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the FormFork form backend and visual form platform (https://formfork.io).

  • Service Provider: FormFork (https://formfork.io)
  • When & What Data is Sent:
    1. Workspace Sync & Form Builder (WP Admin): No external requests are made until an administrator configures a FormFork API key (ff_live_...). Once configured, the plugin sends your API key (X-API-Key), your site’s hostname (X-Site-Domain), plugin version (X-FF-Plugin-Version), and form schema configurations to https://formfork.io/api/v1/forms when viewing synced forms, testing the connection, or saving a form in the Form Builder.
    2. Frontend Form Rendering & Visitor Submissions: When a visitor views a page containing a [formfork] shortcode, Gutenberg block, or Elementor widget, WordPress fetches the form schema from https://formfork.io/api/v1/forms/{id} (cached for 60 seconds via WordPress Transients). When a visitor submits a form, the submitted field values, any uploaded files, and request headers (Origin, Referer, User-Agent, X-Forwarded-For, X-FF-Visitor-IP, X-FF-Proxy-Ts, X-FF-Proxy-Sig, X-FF-Plugin-Version) are transmitted to https://formfork.io/f/{id} (or /api/v1/submit) for per-visitor spam protection and rate limiting. In iframe mode, the browser loads the hosted form from https://formfork.io/share/{id}.
  • Terms of Service: https://formfork.io/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://formfork.io/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install FormFork Connect directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory (Plugins -> Add New -> Search “FormFork Connect”) or upload formfork-connect.zip downloaded from your FormFork Dashboard.
  2. Activate FormFork Connect in WordPress Admin.
  3. Click Launch 60-Second Setup Wizard on the welcome banner (or open FormFork -> All Forms) to connect your API key, create a starter form in 1 click, and publish it on a WordPress page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a FormFork account to use this plugin?

Yes. You can connect a free or paid FormFork workspace (https://formfork.io) using either a full Workspace Server API Key or an Agency Domain-Scoped API Key (ff_live_...).

Can I restrict whether a form is edited in WordPress or on the FormFork Web Dashboard?

Yes. Each form includes an Edit Authority Lock setting (Editable Everywhere, Locked to WordPress Only, or Locked to FormFork Dashboard Only). Form deletion is restricted to the FormFork Web Dashboard to prevent accidental removal from client sites.

Does the server-side proxy cause visitors on shared WordPress hosting to share rate limits?

No. When your WordPress site connects via its API key, FormFork automatically whitelists your WordPress server’s outbound IP (even across rotating shared-hosting egress IPs) and verifies the HMAC-signed X-FF-Visitor-IP header so every visitor is rate-limited individually.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Added multi-proxy visitor IP resolution (get_visitor_ip()) supporting WordPress sites behind Cloudflare, Sucuri, and Nginx reverse proxies (HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP, HTTP_TRUE_CLIENT_IP, HTTP_X_REAL_IP, HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR, REMOTE_ADDR).
  • Added HMAC-SHA256 signed visitor IP forwarding headers (X-FF-Visitor-IP, X-FF-Proxy-Ts, X-FF-Proxy-Sig, X-FF-Plugin-Version) on proxied form submissions so visitors on shared WordPress hosting never share rate-limit buckets and bots cannot spoof proxy headers.
  • Enhanced Test API Connection diagnostics in FormFork -> Settings to display the whitelisted WordPress server IP and Signed Visitor IP Shield status.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release of FormFork Connect.
  • Top-level FormFork WordPress Admin studio menu (All Forms, Form Builder, Settings) with a 3-Step Guided Onboarding Wizard (Connect Workspace -> 1-Click Starter Templates -> Auto-Create Draft WordPress Page).
  • Full-featured Visual Form Builder with multi-step wizards, 15 field types (including Digital Signature Pad, Evaluation Matrix, and File Upload), conditional visibility logic, 9 visual theme presets (frosted-crystal, glassmorphism, soft-neumorph, modern-minimal, midnight-dark, warm-editorial, neo-brutalist, corporate-saas, sunset-coral), and a side-by-side live interactive preview.
  • Edit Authority Lock (unlocked, wordpress_only, dashboard_only) and safe dashboard-only form deletion.
  • Native Elementor Widget (FormFork Form), Gutenberg Block (formfork/form-embed), Classic Editor Form Picker, and [formfork] shortcode.
  • Server-side WordPress AJAX proxy supporting JSON and multipart/form-data binary file uploads, 60-second WordPress Transient caching, live Test API Connection diagnostics, and Agency Domain-Scoped Key support.
